mechanism.claim: When an already volatile completed BTC day shifts an unusually large share of its quadratic variation into the final three hours while the first twenty-one hours and final three hours retain one direction, the late variance ignition is directional price discovery that persists for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: common strict nonzero sign of completed first-21-hour and final-3-hour returns
mechanism.why_distinct: SPVTA measured variance relocation between spot and perpetual markets with opposite-half geometry. HVRSR used a signed third moment, HVVRCR used return-volume covariance, and RBEFR used high-low versus body variance. HVTVIR uses within-perpetual temporal concentration of quadratic variation plus cross-subwindow direction agreement, reuses no event set, and promotes no control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed 24-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one sparse 02:05 UTC variance-ignition clock is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: every calendar day at exact 02:00 UTC
features.return_window: 288 completed five-minute close-to-close log returns in [decision-24h, decision), requiring 289 contiguous finite positive closes including the predecessor close
features.early_return: sum of the first 252 completed five-minute log returns (21 hours)
features.late_return: sum of the final 36 completed five-minute log returns (3 hours)
features.late_variance_share: sum of final-36 return squares divided by sum of all 288 return squares; denominator must be strictly positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 prior valid daily observations, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.ignition_rank: strict-prior midrank of late_variance_share over at most 90 prior valid daily observations, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.direction_agreement: early_return and late_return have the same strict nonzero sign

clock.decision: exact daily 02:00 UTC after all 288 returns are complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: within-day temporal concentration of quadratic variation under directional persistence

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no window, variance-share definition, rank, agreement, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
